title: Trump tinkers with immigration strategy as Miller lurks behind the scenes
text: Trump tinkers with immigration strategy as Miller lurks behind the scenesTom Homan said he's pulling hundreds of immigration agents out of Minneapolis, which would still leave 2,000 agents in the city. And Trump says he may use a "softer touch" with his immigration crackdown. But will any of this make a difference, especially with Stephen Miller having so much power in the White House?
